# Eureka Forbes

> > Eureka Forbes is India's leading home appliance brand offering water purifiers, vacuum cleaners, and air purifiers with advanced filtration technologies and smart IoT capabilities.

Eureka Forbes provides a comprehensive range of home water purification solutions under the Aquaguard brand, including RO+UV+UF multi-stage filtration systems, robotic vacuum cleaners with smart mapping, and air purification products. The site features product catalogs, detailed specifications, exchange offers, and after-sales support including AMC plans and filter replacements.
